colleges.overview:
Indian Institute of Information Technology Design and Manufacturing, Kurnool (IIITDM Kurnool) was established in 2014 and began its academic operations in 2015. It is fully funded by the Ministry of Education, Government of India, and was granted Institute of National Importance status through an amendment to the IIIT Act in 2017. The permanent campus is located at Jagannathagattu Hill, Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh, in the Rayalaseema region. The institute describes the campus as a hilltop setting overlooking Kurnool city, providing a peaceful environment for academic, research and student activities.
